# Student AI Disclosure

> Student-side disclosure attached to submitted work.

An open JSON spec for student-side disclosure attached to submitted artifacts: AI tools used (with back-refs to Agent Cards / Tutor Cards), 13-value role taxonomy, prompt evidence (full / hashed / omitted), artifact-hash binding, AUP reference, teacher acknowledgment. Disclosure is the lawful state — the spec punishes omission, not AI use.

## Identity

- **Subdomain**: [student.kineticgain.com](https://student.kineticgain.com/)
- **Spec repo**: [github.com/mizcausevic-dev/student-ai-disclosure-spec](https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/student-ai-disclosure-spec)
- **Detect via**: top-level `disclosure_version` field in the JSON document
- **Buyer audience**: Academic Integrity · LMS · School administrators
- **Category**: EdTech extension — Student AI Disclosure (student-side)
- **License**: AGPL-3.0 for spec text; Apache-2.0 for the landing site
- **Deployment**: GitHub Actions FTP CI/CD on push to main

## Part of the Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite

A family of **10 open JSON specifications** for the answer-engine and agent era — five core (AEO, Prompt Provenance, Agent Cards, AI Evidence Format, MCP Tool Cards), a three-spec EdTech trio (Tutor Cards / Student AI Disclosure / Classroom AI AUP), a HealthTech extension (Clinical AI Disclosure), and a cross-cutting Incident Card. **Two regulated verticals covered.**

- **Front door**: [suite.kineticgain.com](https://suite.kineticgain.com/)
- **Quickstart hub**: [docs.kineticgain.com](https://docs.kineticgain.com/)
- **Unified MCP server** (34 tools, 8 specs, v0.4.0): [github.com/mizcausevic-dev/mcp-kinetic-gain](https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/mcp-kinetic-gain)
